_comment: Single source of truth for Forged Ascent. Read by the Java mod (registration) and tools/gen_assets.py (textures, models, recipes, tags, worldgen, names). 'style' names the All the Ores metal whose ingot/raw/ore/block textures are recolored. 'tools_from'/'armor_from' name the pack textures recolored for gear (the sword is our own sprite). Armor defense is per piece; move_speed, burning_time and luck are per piece. Gems: ore blocks listed in ores drop rough_<id>; cutting a rough gem with a wheel that cuts its hardness gives item.
